page_title: BOL 0-0 NAP | Bologna v Napoli 24/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+6' A cross into the box from Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is cleared.
90+5' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
90+4' A yellow card is awarded to Mario Rui (Napoli).
90+3' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
90+1' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Jens Cajuste (Napoli) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
88' Poor challenge! Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is penalised for tripping and Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle.
86' Rudi Garcia has decided to make a change. Jens Cajuste (Napoli) replaces Stanislav Lobotka.
86' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Victor Osimhen as he is replaced by Giovanni Simeone (Napoli).
85' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall.
84' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Napoli.
84' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle and signals a foul after Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna) brought his opponent down.
82' Thiago Motta prepares a substitution. Jesper Karlsson is replaced by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna).
82' Remo Freuler will be replaced by Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna).
82' Matteo Politano (Napoli) gets booked for the first time in this match.
81' Remo Freuler (Bologna) has tested the patience of referee Giovanni Ayroldi and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
81' Jesper Karlsson (Bologna) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.

79' Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Giovanni Ayroldi blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
76' Substitution. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia makes his way off the pitch and Eljif Elmas (Napoli) comes on as his replacement.
75' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bologna comes to nothing.
75' A corner kick by Bologna is thwarted by the well prepared Alex Meret (Napoli).

75' The ball goes out for a corner. Bologna can continue in their attacking effort. Nice individual effort by Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a shot to the middle of the goal, but Alex Meret does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out.
72' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) misses the penalty! His poor effort goes well wide of the right post.
72' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) is going to take the penalty!
72' Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
71' Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
70' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle after Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
67' That's the end of the game for Giacomo Raspadori, who is replaced by Matteo Politano (Napoli).
65' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
65' Thiago Motta decides to make a substitution. Jhon Lucumi will be replaced by Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna).
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) will replace Dan Ndoye.
63' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) commits a foul and Giovanni Ayroldi immediately signals a free kick.
60' A dangerous looking corner kick from Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) is cleared to safety by the defence.
59' Napoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
59' Napoli can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
57' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bologna.
55' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
54' Natan (Napoli) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
53' Giovanni Ayroldi shows a yellow card to Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) for his blatant foul.
53' Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
52' The corner is swung in but Bologna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
49' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Giovanni Ayroldi had an easy-decision to make.
48' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
46' Half-time substitution. Rudi Garcia decided to make a change. Mathias Olivera is replaced by Mario Rui (Napoli).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The end of the first half.

45+2' That's unlucky! Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' That's unlucky! Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
41' The Napoli players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
37' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the bottom right corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Lukasz Skorupski.
34' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle for a foul.
33' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
32' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) jumps into a tackle and Giovanni Ayroldi signals a foul.
30' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Michel Aebischer (Bologna) was quite harsh and Giovanni Ayroldi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
29' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Frank Anguissa (Napoli), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
27' The resulting corner from Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
27' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
26' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
23' The resulting set piece from Bologna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
20' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
18' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
17' Sam Beukema (Bologna) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle for an infringement.
14' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Piotr Zielinski (Napoli), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
13' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
10' Thiago Motta is forced to make a change. Stefan Posch (Bologna) is unable to continue due to injury, Lorenzo De Silvestri comes on.
10' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) gets free in the box and latches onto a good cross, but somehow he sends the ball narrowly wide of the right post from the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat.
7' Stefan Posch (Bologna) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
6' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
6' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the left post to safety.
4' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Victor Osimhen, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
1' Napoli are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
1' Sam Beukema (Bologna) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Napoli will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Giovanni Ayroldi.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
